lines.text: Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem fears Gibeon's peace with Israel and calls four kings, and five Amorite kings camp before Gibeon.
Gibeon sends word to Joshua at Gilgal, and the LORD tells him not to be afraid.
After marching all night from Gilgal, Joshua surprises them, and the LORD throws them into darkness before Israel.
Hailstones from the sky kill more than Israel's swords, and Joshua calls for the sun to stand still over Gibeon and the moon over the Valley of Aijalon.
No day was like it because the LORD listened to a man, and Joshua returned with Israel to Shiloh.
